verdict.rationale: Mixpanel has a documented Feature Flags API for assigning users to variants (mixpanel-docs-36) and a hosted MCP server (mixpanel-docs-10, mixpanel-probe-3), but the MCP server's documented capabilities only cover dashboard creation and natural-language querying of analytics data (mixpanel-docs-11, mixpanel-docs-19), with no evidence of flag creation, targeting, or toggling through MCP. Missing for 10: MCP server tools for flag creation/targeting/toggling, detailed API endpoints for creating and toggling flags (not just assigning variants), and any hands-on confirmation an agent can perform this workflow end-to-end.
